Class GameLogic

java.lang.Object
Model.GameLogic
public class GameLogic extends Object
Manages the core state, rules, turns, and scoring of the game board.

    • clickCell

      public void clickCell(int r, int c)
      Processes a move at the given grid coordinates by incrementing the clicked cell and its orthogonal neighbors, then advancing the turn if unowned cells remain.
      Parameters:
      r - the row index of the clicked cell
      c - the column index of the clicked cell

    • getCellOwner

      public int getCellOwner(int r, int c)
      Returns the owner index of the cell at the specified position.
      Parameters:
      r - the row index
      c - the column index
      Returns:
      the owner index (-1 if unowned, 0 for Player 1, 1 for Player 2)

    • getWinner

      public Player getWinner()
      Determines the winning player based on the highest score.
